November 3, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Rating Reaffirmed
New York: In a research report revealed on 2 November, JMP Securities reaffirmed their Market Outperform rating on Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares. They now have a $1375 price target on the company. JMP Securities’s target would indicate a potential upside of 28.33 % from the company’s stock close price. Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Ratings Coverage
Among 14 analysts covering Alphabet Inc ( NASDAQ:GOOGL ), 12 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 86% are positive. Alphabet Inc has $1515 highest and $1140 lowest target. $1370.79’s average target is 27.93% above currents $1071.49 stock price. Alphabet Inc had 22 analyst reports since May 17, Bank of America maintained the shares of GOOGL in report on Friday, October 26 with “Buy” rating. The stock of Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) has “Overweight” rating given on Wednesday, August 29 by Morgan Stanley. Morgan Stanley maintained Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) rating on Friday, June 1. Morgan Stanley has “Buy” rating and $120000 target. The company was maintained on Tuesday, July 24 by Credit Suisse. Morgan Stanley maintained the shares of GOOGL in report on Thursday, June 28 with “Overweight” rating. The company was maintained on Thursday, May 17 by Aegis Capital. The firm has “Overweight” rating given on Friday, July 13 by Barclays Capital. The rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley with “Overweight” on Tuesday, July 24. Bank of America maintained it with “Buy” rating and $1390 target in Tuesday, July 24 report. Canaccord Genuity maintained Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) rating on Friday, October 26. Canaccord Genuity has “Hold” rating and $1140 target.
The stock decreased 1.33% or $14.49 $1071.49. About 1.96M shares traded. Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) has risen 23.76% uptrending. It has outperformed by 8.14% the S&P500.
Alphabet Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides online advertising services in the United States, the United Kingdom, and rest of the world. $739.80 billion. The firm offers performance and brand advertising services. It has a 46.27 P/E ratio. It operates through Google and Other Bets divisions.
